adminAutoBackupSettings:
query AdminAutoBackupSettings {
      autoBackupSettings {
        includeSystemConfigs
        enabled
        frequency
        dataStorageID
        includeChannels
        includeModels
        includeAPIKeys
        includeModelPrices
        includeUsageStats
        includeRequestLogs
        retentionDays
        lastBackupAt
        lastBackupError
      }
